ValidationRule.description: Contact Name,(Customer ID/Operational Acc/Billing Acc), Category and Sub Category are required when Case status is Resolved. The epic for reference #1008 #15668#23176.#29931- Removed AccountId
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Global_Service_Case', OR( (AND(ISBLANK( ContactId ),Is_IM_Employee__c = False)), AND(ISBLANK(Customer_ID__c),ISBLANK(GSC_Billing_Account__c),ISBLANK(GSC_Operational_Account__c)),
ISPICKVAL( GSC_Category__c , "" ), ISPICKVAL( GSC_Sub_Category__c , "" ) ), ISPICKVAL( Status, "Resolved" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Contact Name, (Customer ID/Operational Acc/Billing Acc), Category and Sub Category are required to close the Case as Resolved.
